parties.respondent: The State Rep. By The Inspector Of Police

summary: Conviction under Section 302 IPC challenged based on collapse of prosecution case; key witnesses disbelieved—eyewitness Tr. Arokiya Sesuraja (PW2) and extra-judicial confessions of co-accused (A2, A3) rejected by High Court; no river sand recovered from tractor-trailer, undermining prosecution motive; delay in FIR presentation to Magistrate (10 hours) unreasonably explained; electronic evidence, fingerprints, and slippers insufficient to sustain conviction; benefit of doubt extended; conviction set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence under Section 302 IPC set aside; appellant acquitted.
